descriptions.en: Outcome of migrating this concept relative to the source model.
descriptions.cs: Výsledek migrace tohoto konceptu vůči zdrojovému modelu.

descriptions.en: Primary transformation action applied to this concept during migration.
descriptions.cs: Hlavní transformační akce aplikovaná na tento koncept při migraci.

descriptions.en: Identifier or name of the transformation rule that produced this concept.
descriptions.cs: Identifikátor nebo název transformačního pravidla, které koncept vytvořilo.

descriptions.en: Primary source identifier in the legacy model for this concept.
descriptions.cs: Primární identifikátor zdroje v legacy modelu pro tento koncept.

descriptions.en: All source identifiers that contributed to this concept (multi-value; used for merges/splits).
descriptions.cs: Všechny identifikátory zdrojů, které přispěly k tomuto konceptu (více hodnot; pro merge/split).

descriptions.en: Type or class name of the concept in the source model.
descriptions.cs: Typ nebo název třídy konceptu ve zdrojovém modelu.

descriptions.en: Display name of the concept in the source model at migration time.
descriptions.cs: Zobrazovaný název konceptu ve zdrojovém modelu v okamžiku migrace.

descriptions.en: Confidence that the transformation is correct.
descriptions.cs: Míra jistoty, že transformace je správná.

descriptions.en: Batch or run identifier grouping concepts migrated together.
descriptions.cs: Identifikátor dávky nebo běhu sdružující společně migrované koncepty.

descriptions.en: When this concept was written or last updated by the migration (ISO-8601 preferred).
descriptions.cs: Kdy migrace tento koncept zapsala nebo naposledy aktualizovala (preferován ISO-8601).

descriptions.en: Free-text audit note explaining the transformation decision.
descriptions.cs: Volný text s auditním vysvětlením rozhodnutí o transformaci.

descriptions.en: Optional audit metadata for transforming an architecture model (e.g. legacy ArchiMate → archimate-lite ORGX). Not ArchiMate semantics. Depends on kc-base and archimate-lite. Drop after migration is complete.
descriptions.cs: Volitelná auditní metadata pro transformaci architektonického modelu (např. legacy ArchiMate → archimate-lite ORGX). Není ArchiMate sémantika. Závisí na kc-base a archimate-lite. Po dokončení migrace lze odstranit.

value.string: Audit field for architecture transformation. unchanged = kept as-is; transformed = type/shape changed; split/merged = cardinality change; created = new intermediate; deprecated/rejected = not carried forward; needsReview = requires human check. Not ArchiMate semantics — remove package when migration is done.
transformed after TYPE_CHANGED; merged for duplicate actors; needsReview when confidence is low; unchanged for stable Location.

Recommended vocabulary (open): TYPE_CHANGED, RELATIONSHIP_CHANGED, NAME_NORMALIZED, SPLIT_ELEMENT, MERGED_DUPLICATE, CREATED_INTERMEDIATE, REMOVED_ORPHAN, FIXED_REFERENCE, UNCHANGED. Prefer one primary action; detail in migrationNotes / migrationRule.
TYPE_CHANGED BusinessActor→BusinessRole; MERGED_DUPLICATE two CRM components; CREATED_INTERMEDIATE ApplicationService; UNCHANGED.
Stable rule id/name from the migration playbook or script (not free-form narrative — use migrationNotes for that).
Single primary source id (Exchange id, Archi UUID, or legacy iriLocal). For many-to-one merges prefer migrationSourceIds and set this to the canonical source.
Multi-valued. Use for MERGED_DUPLICATE / SPLIT_ELEMENT audit trails. Keep migrationSourceId as the primary/canonical source when one exists.
id-10 and id-11 merged into one BusinessActor; split sources listed on each resulting element.
Legacy ArchiMate (or other) type string before transformation — helps audit TYPE_CHANGED.
Snapshot of the legacy label for audit when NAME_NORMALIZED or when the target name differs.
CRM systém; Odbor ICT; SYSA → Data měření flow.
high = unambiguous from source data; medium = likely but needs review; low = working hypothesis; manual = human-confirmed. Pair medium/low with migrationStatus=needsReview until confirmed.
high for 1:1 type map; medium for inferred BusinessFunction; manual after architect review.
Use a stable batch id (date + wave, pipeline run id) so auditors can filter one transformation pass.
Prefer UTC ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-09-04T09:15:00Z). Tool-written; do not use as ArchiMate lifecycleState.
Human-readable rationale, exceptions, and follow-ups. Keep machine rule ids in migrationRule; status/action in their properties.
External vendor was incorrectly typed as Collaboration — remapped to BusinessActor organization+external.; Split L1 process into L1+L2 per ORGX hierarchy.
